snippet.title: Ritual of Raven - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Ritual of Raven is a story-based farming sim - but you don’t do the farming yourself! Enchant Arcana Constructs to grow a magical herb garden, befriend a cute bunch of weirdos and use your witchy skills to perform powerful rituals to stabilize the portals that are causing trouble for the village. Watch the latest Ritual of Raven trailer for another look at the magical world. Ritual of Raven will be available on PC and Switch on August 17.
